mentions.name: zicl
mentions.description: A Tcl interpreter reimplemented from C in Zig, based on the design of Jimtcl. Its key difference is thread-safe value sharing, with lexical variable capture planned. Commands evaluate and basic object operations are in place, though core commands still need implementation. It originated as a sub-project of folk.computer and may eventually be swapped in there.
mentions.problem: folk.computer incurs about a 20% overhead serializing and deserializing values sent between threads, which also prevents sending large amounts of data around; a previous attempt to make the Jimtcl interpreter thread-safe ended up slower than the status quo.
mentions.source_excerpt: Porting/reimplementing a Tcl interpreter from C to Zig, based on the design of Jimtcl. This is one of those sub-projects that started due to another project (folk.computer in this case). The biggest difference is thread-safe value sharing, and (soon to be) lexical variable capture.
